title: Infinite Crisis #1 DC Comics December 2005 Geoff Johns Phil Jimenez Cover
condition_description: Bright cover with light handling wear; small chip on the bottom edge of the back cover. See photos.
description:
Infinite Crisis #1 (of 7) (DC Comics, December 2005). "The Countdown Is Over!" Written by Geoff Johns, art by Phil Jimenez and Andy Lanning. Superman, Batman and Wonder Woman cover by Jimenez. Direct Sales edition, $3.99 cover price.

Back cover: Army Reserve ad.

Condition: bright cover with light handling wear; small chip on the bottom edge of the back cover (see close-up).

Ships bagged in a protective mailer.
